one_sentence_story: Tell your brain not to think of a white bear, and a hidden check looks for bears fast. The thought bounces back unless you pick one clear thing to picture.
so_what_for_you: Drop 'do not' rules at 3 a.m. or under stress. Give your mind one clear task, like making warm tea or aiming at the cup.

jargon_map.plain: a pushed-back thought jumps back stronger once you stop fighting it
jargon_map.analogy: like holding a beach ball down in water until it shoots up

jargon_map.plain: your search for new thoughts, which burns fuel and gets tired fast
jargon_map.analogy: like a tired driver trying to dodge holes on a dark road

jargon_map.plain: a fast check that asks if the banned thought came back yet
jargon_map.analogy: like a guard who yells 'Stay quiet!' every ten seconds

jargon_map.plain: locking your mind on one clear thing instead of a ban
jargon_map.analogy: like tuning a car radio to one clean song instead of static
